record.paper_title: Some Open Questions in Quiver Gauge Theory
record.original_question: Classify all elementary slices that occur in these moduli-space constructions, including elementary slices that do not arise from affine Grassmannians.

evidence.quote: Question 11. Classify all the elementary slices.

artifact.status_search_result: Recent literature (e.g., works on Hasse diagrams for symplectic singularities, magnetic quivers, and the decay/fission algorithm from 2022–2024) treats the classification of elementary slices as an active open problem. New families of elementary slices beyond minimal nilpotent orbits and Kleinian singularities have been found via Coulomb branch constructions, but no complete classification is established. There is a working conjecture that elementary slices for generic symplectic singularities coincide with those between adjacent nilpotent orbit closures, but it remains unproven.

status_evidence.title: The Higgs Mechanism – Hasse Diagrams for Symplectic Singularities
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses elementary slices and proposes that they consist mainly of nilpotent orbit closures and Kleinian singularities; classification is treated as an open question.
status_evidence.claim: Classification of elementary slices is presented as an open program.

status_evidence.title: Decay and Fission of Magnetic Quivers
status_evidence.snippet: Uses an algorithm to systematically search magnetic quivers whose Coulomb branches are isolated conical symplectic singularities, motivated by the goal of classifying elementary transverse slices.
status_evidence.claim: Recent (2023) work still pursues classification, indicating the problem remains open.

status_evidence.title: Quiver gauge theories and symplectic singularities
status_evidence.snippet: Establishes that Coulomb branches of many quiver gauge theories have symplectic singularities, providing a source of new candidate elementary slices.
status_evidence.claim: Provides new elementary slices not from affine Grassmannians, but does not classify them.
